name: Vosnesensky Bumble Bee
desc: Vosnesensky Bumble Bee (Bombus vosnesenskii): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 89 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bombus vosnesenskii, the yellow-faced bumblebee, is a species of bumblebee native to the west coast of North America, where it is distributed from British Columbia to Baja California.
